M-CART.NAME: Cart
M-CART.purpose: Maintain a shopping cart with validated quantities and exact totals.

fn-createCart.PURPOSE: Cart exports createCart with validated inputs and explicit errors.

fn-addItem.PURPOSE: Cart exports addItem with validated inputs and explicit errors.

fn-subtotalCents.PURPOSE: Cart exports subtotalCents with validated inputs and explicit errors.

fn-renderSubtotal.PURPOSE: Cart exports renderSubtotal with validated inputs and explicit errors.

type-CART_INVALID.PURPOSE: Cart validation error raised on invalid input.

contract.purpose: Maintain a shopping cart with validated quantities and exact totals.

param.name: input
param.description: Cart validates every input before use and reports errors explicitly.

param.name: result
param.description: Cart returns deterministic results; failures throw instead of returning sentinel values.

error.description: Raised when Cart receives invalid input.

M-CART.notes: Cart mutations validate quantity and stock before storing an item. Totals are computed in cents through the money module, never with floats.
